title: ALE, interfaces and partitioned multiphysics coupling

items.title: Conditional finite-dimensional Lie and Strang splitting residual orders
items.statement: For two C3 vector fields on a common compact convex tube with exact subflows and the hypotheses of the cited finite-dimensional splitting theorem, Lie and Strang updates have global orders one and two respectively; approximate subflow errors remain separate under the theorem's explicit budgets and stability bound.
items.strategy: Instantiate the exact finite-dimensional Lie-Strang theorem and preserve all of its common-tube, regularity, exact-flow, and approximate-subflow hypotheses.

items.title: Finite-dimensional backward-Euler diffusion transmission model
items.statement: Two finite-dimensional real subdomain spaces have positive-definite mass and coercive diffusion matrices; backward Euler produces positive-definite local blocks, a common nonzero trace space, local Schur fluxes q_i=S_i lambda_i-f_i, trace continuity, and monolithic flux balance q_1+q_2=0.
items.strategy: Define the real inner products, matrix blocks, trace coordinates, local flux sign, condensed data, and monolithic interface conditions.

items.title: ALE moving-domain map and mesh velocity
items.statement: A C2 orientation-preserving diffeomorphism A_t from a fixed bounded reference domain with compact Jordan closure; in dimension one the domain is a finite union of intervals, and in dimension at least two it has a finite piecewise-C1 boundary presentation. Define J=det D_xi A_t>0 and w_m=partial_t A_t composed with A_t^{-1}.
items.strategy: Define the map, its domains, regularity, Jacobian, and spatial mesh velocity.

items.title: Periodic one-dimensional moving grid
items.statement: A finite N-cell periodic reference grid with positive cell Jacobians J_i^n, periodic face velocities w_{i+1/2}^n, face update x_{i+1/2}^{n+1}=x_{i+1/2}^n+Delta t w_{i+1/2}^n, and constant physical advection speed a.
items.strategy: State the periodic indexing, positive cell widths, time step, face motion, and relative speed convention.

items.title: Scalar added-mass staggered recurrence
items.statement: For structure mass m_s>0, fluid added mass m_f>0, and scalar velocity increment delta v_n, the specified toy sequential update is m_s delta v_{n+1}=-m_f delta v_n.
items.strategy: Declare the exact scalar recurrence and its restricted toy-model scope.

items.title: Conservative upwind ALE finite-volume step
items.statement: Move the periodic faces, return mesh_crossing before state update if any new J_i is nonpositive, otherwise use the relative-speed upwind flux and conservative cell-average update specified in the Definition.
items.strategy: Give exact inputs, status branch, flux convention, update order, and output.

items.title: Jacobi identity for the ALE mesh Jacobian
items.statement: For the ALE map A_t, the Jacobian satisfies partial_t J=J div_x w_m.
items.strategy: Differentiate the determinant and identify the trace of the spatial velocity gradient.

items.title: Moving faces satisfy the one-dimensional discrete GCL
items.statement: The periodic face update gives J_i^{n+1}=J_i^n+(Delta t/Delta xi)(w_{i+1/2}^n-w_{i-1/2}^n).
items.strategy: Subtract the two adjacent face updates and divide by Delta xi.

items.title: The diffusion Schur complement is positive and minimizes energy
items.statement: For a symmetric positive-definite local backward-Euler block, its Schur complement on the trace space is positive definite and its quadratic form is the minimum local energy among states with that trace.
items.strategy: Complete the square in interior variables and use positivity of the full local block.

items.title: Monolithic backward Euler transmission energy identity
items.statement: For matching traces and balanced outward interface fluxes, the finite-dimensional monolithic backward-Euler step has a unique solution and satisfies the exact mass-energy difference identity with the time-jump, diffusion-dissipation, and forcing terms.
items.strategy: Use positive definiteness for unique solvability, cancel paired interface flux work, test by the new state, and expand the mass inner product.

items.title: Finite-budget Robin-Robin transmission iteration
items.statement: For positive-definite Schur operators S_1,S_2, loads f_i, alpha>0, incoming datum r_1^0, tolerance epsilon>0, and finite pass budget M>=1, perform the two Robin solves and exchanges; return a trace only when the stated contraction-based stop test passes, otherwise return budget_exhausted with the last trace.
items.strategy: Specify each sequential solve and exchange, the finite stopping rule, and the exhaustion output.

items.title: Schur residual controls trace and reconstruction energy error
items.statement: If rho=(S_1+S_2)lambda_tilde-(f_1+f_2), then the trace error is bounded by ||(S_1+S_2)^{-1}|| ||rho|| and the reconstructed subdomain backward-Euler energy error is bounded by sqrt(||(S_1+S_2)^{-1}||)||rho||.
items.strategy: Express trace error through the inverse Schur sum and use the Schur energy-minimization identity.

items.title: Choice-free one-dimensional ALE Reynolds transport identity
items.statement: For a one-dimensional ALE map on a finite union of bounded intervals and C1 scalar data, the moving-domain integral derivative equals the spatial integral of partial_t g plus the endpoint flux sum; this branch is proved without Choice.
items.strategy: Differentiate on the fixed finite union of intervals, change variables, and apply the one-dimensional fundamental theorem on each endpoint pair.

items.title: Reynolds transport identity on an ALE moving domain
items.statement: Assume Countable Choice and d>=2. For g C1 on the moving domain, d/dt int_{Omega(t)} g dx=int_{Omega(t)} partial_t g dx+int_{partial Omega(t)} g w_m dot n dS under the stated ALE and finite piecewise-C1 boundary hypotheses.
items.strategy: Pull the integral back to the fixed reference domain, differentiate using Jacobi's identity, then apply change of variables and the divergence theorem.

items.title: The upwind ALE step conserves mass and preserves constants
items.statement: Whenever the ALE step succeeds, it preserves periodic total mass and maps every constant cell state to the same constant, for every face-velocity table; no CFL condition is needed for these two properties.
items.strategy: Sum the periodic flux differences for mass and use the discrete GCL to cancel mesh-flux changes for a constant state.

items.title: Robin-Robin iteration contracts to the monolithic trace
items.statement: For positive-definite S_i and alpha>0, the Robin-Robin fixed point is exactly the unique monolithic trace; the homogeneous incoming-data error map is R_2 R_1 with R_i=(alpha I-S_i)(alpha I+S_i)^{-1}; the finite stop test certifies trace error at most epsilon.
items.strategy: Prove fixed-point equivalence, diagonalize the positive Schur operators to get strict contractions, and sum the geometric tail for the stop certificate.

items.title: CFL monotonicity and weighted L1 contraction for the ALE step
items.statement: If (Delta t/Delta xi)(c_{i+1/2}^+-c_{i-1/2}^-)<=J_i^n for every cell and all new Jacobians are positive, then the upwind ALE update is monotone, preserves nonnegative states, and contracts the Jacobian-weighted discrete L1 norm of differences.
items.strategy: Expand the update into nonnegative neighbor coefficients, use constant preservation for row sums, and use mass conservation for weighted column sums.

title: ALE, interfaces and partitioned multiphysics coupling — Examples

items.title: A toy sequential coupling can amplify velocity error
items.statement: For the defined recurrence with m_s=1, m_f=2, and nonzero delta v_0, the increments satisfy delta v_n=(-2)^n delta v_0 and grow geometrically in magnitude.
items.strategy: Iterate the scalar recurrence and compare successive absolute values.

items.title: An expanding cell preserves a constant state
items.statement: On a two-cell periodic grid with Delta xi=1, Delta t=0.1, a=0, face velocities 0 and 0.1, and initial cell averages U, the first cell expands to Jacobian 1.01, the second contracts to 0.99, and the ALE update preserves U and total mass 2U.
items.strategy: Compute both updated Jacobians, relative fluxes, and the two cell updates exactly.

items.title: A two-domain heat trace balances outward fluxes
items.statement: For two positive-definite condensed backward-Euler blocks with S_1=2, S_2=1, f_1=1, f_2=5, alpha=1, incoming datum r_1^0=2, tolerance 0.1, and budget two, the monolithic trace is 2, the outward fluxes are 3 and -3, and the partitioned iteration certifies the exact trace on its second pass.
items.strategy: Exhibit positive local blocks realizing the stated Schur scalars and perform both Robin passes exactly.
